rules: This operator profile accepts the displayed whole-ETB presets from1.00 through40000.00 ETB. These amounts are a local operator choice, not conversion of the demo currency.

The next paid Spin first collects an accepted pending win. Collection and optional red/black doubling never debit a second stake.

A current win of at most500.00 ETB may be risked on red or black up to five times. A fair independent attempt doubles it or loses it. No successful doubled win is clipped. Availability also respects the fixed round liability reserved before the outcome.

math.returnQualification: The inherited coefficient-profile return precedes currency flooring. Newly allowed wagers with fractional santim may have a rounding difference; no provider-private RTP is claimed.

rules: This operator profile accepts the displayed whole-ETB presets from1.00 through40000.00 ETB. These amounts are a local operator choice, not conversion of the demo currency.

This independent native probability profile has an exact theoretical return of 95.230281632%. Its fixed weighted reel windows or cells and feature probabilities do not depend on the player, balance, stake or history. They are not the provider's private probabilities.
The complete native outcome support pays the public coefficients in full within a proved bound of 1100 times total stake. No supported win is reduced by a payout ceiling.

A newly paid or improved winning combination freezes the participating reels; only the remaining reels respin. Previously paid line/scatter amounts are retained, and only increases are added. The native sequence ends when there is no improvement or all reels are frozen. Each continuation adds a frozen reel, making the existing five-frame bound redundant. This payment recurrence is an explicit independent native rule.
Clover expands on reels 2, 3, 4, preserving every Dollar scatter.
This40-line variant has no assumed lucky-coin effect.

Highest left-to-right regular award per line. Dollar scatter pays3/20/100 times total stake for3/4/5 or more symbols anywhere; one highest scatter award adds to line wins.  The raw reference scatter coefficients multiply total stake divided by40.

The complete slot outcome and automatic respin/extra-Wild sequence are resolved by the server from one stake. A manual winning round waits for Take Win; paid autoplay may request autoCollect when the round starts.
The next paid Spin first collects an accepted pending win. Collection and optional red/black doubling never debit a second stake.

A current win of at most500.00 ETB may be risked on red or black up to five times. A fair independent attempt doubles it or loses it. No successful doubled win is clipped. Availability also respects the fixed round liability reserved before the outcome.
A disconnected pending win is automatically collected after30 minutes. Reloading restores the same accepted round and does not draw again.

The exact sum of all public coefficient awards is calculated before a single floor to santim. Increasing the wager scales the exact award ratio; displayed and settled minor-unit amounts account for that final rounding.
The full potential liability is reserved before sampling. Insufficient house reserve rejects before debit. High wagers never invoke the former absolute monetary payout ceiling.

gamble.limitMeaning: Independent ETB rule: a current win up to500.00 may be doubled, up to five attempts, within the reserved liability. A larger current win is collection-only. The raw public500 DMO field does not verify the provider pre/post-double eligibility boundary.

collection.policy: ZPLAY30-minute disconnect safeguard; not a claim about the provider timeout.

operatorWagerProfile.source: User-requested independent operator wager range; not a provider currency conversion.
